system.description: Once per long rest, when you trigger a charge, destroy, collapse, open, or disable its target to create a major breach, escape route, or obstruction. Adversaries within Close range make a Reaction Roll (16). On a failure, they take 3d10 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained. On a success, they take half damage.
